headline: The neighbours finally fall out
lede: HOMEBODY's Fern and Ivy could be ignored patiently forever — now half a minute of watched-but-unheard waiting cracks the pair, cold war and all, with hearts at the reunion.

notes.text: #2604 shipped: neighbours SPAT — a third-party grudge mirrored from the household cold-war law. Souring timer (30 s, any peace resets it), a named crack with sparks and ash on the NEIGH row, silence while cold, absence-thaw and a once-paid reunion. No rng; the pair ledger rides the state hash.

peoplecheck 751/751 (+29 gates): boundary exactness, three reset cases, cold-war silence on all three pair-pays, the SPAT_CD mirror, and a seed-exact scripted quarrel. Hand-mutant (neuter the cold-war return) dies by name on four gates.

Owed to the QA pass #2599: pair storm-puff/lean while cold, a sour murmur beat (the household's grudge-cool idiom), and a teal sparkle for pair reunions. A homebodydrive leg for the new banners is owed too.
